findings.title: Do not require a non-flow copy sample when all prompt devices use flow
findings.finding: The new unconditional startup check runs whenever cp_dma is true, but its member filter skips cp->flow. Current upstream enables flow by default for TP1 all-GGUF devices (4420-4449); TP2 can also put all members on flow with DS4_FLOW_TP=1. When copied experts are successfully pinned, cp_dma is true but no non-flow member is eligible, so n remains zero and line12823 rejects an otherwise supported load. This is a source-level startup regression introduced by making the formerly opt-in check unconditional.
findings.requested_change: Determine whether the non-flow prompt-copy path is actually applicable before requiring samples. An all-flow configuration should report a bounded not-applicable result for this check, or use the separate existing flow copy checker where intended. Do not claim standalone prompt-copy coverage for flow. Cover TP1 all-flow and TP2 all-flow admission decisions without requiring a model run.

findings.title: Run the pinned prompt-copy check after late pinning changes cp_dma
findings.finding: The check at4547 executes before the current upstream cp_pin_last()/cp_pin() call at4606. On Windows (default pin-last) or explicit DS4_PIN_LAST=1, cp_dma is still false at4547; successful late pinning then enables the direct DMA path after the check. Without optional TP checks the startup validation is entirely skipped. Even if the optional non-DMA check ran, it exercised the pre-pinning staged path, not the newly enabled direct path.
findings.requested_change: Place the guarded check after the final cp_pin decision and before any actual request or calibration use of that path, preserving startup/thread ordering. Keep the all-flow applicability distinction from the first finding. Cover successful late pinning and late pin failure decisions.

bounded_acceptance: All six changed ablate call sites pass the actual layer index; current layer initialization uses il>=g.nl for MTP, so target_layer excludes drafter blocks consistently.
Projection signature matches unchanged upstream project_out; reference formula matches the upstream kernel operation. Numerical tolerance and real device execution remain unqualified.
Complete declared B-tensor byte bounds precede all-expert comparisons, and shape short-circuiting protects dimension indexing. The effective scale check follows metadata multiplication.

Mixed GGUF expert types use the current upstream expert_type-aware format key and tp_copy_member rather than reinstating obsolete Q5/cache kernels. No additional ABI mismatch identified in the inspected delta.
